about_the_game:
"Start with a handful of soldiers and rise to become a lord who shakes the battlefield!"

War of Banners is a strategy real-time combat RPG set in a medieval world.

Explore a vast, living world freely—recruit and train your own order of knights, lead them into battle, and conquer new territories.

This is more than just combat; every soldier's life matters, and each choice you make can shift the tide of war.

Small skirmishes turn into grand stories, all shaped by your decisions and command.

Experience the weight of realistic warfare and the thrill of player-driven tactics in War of Banners.

Explore a Vast Medieval World

Travel freely across a sprawling continent and encounter diverse factions.

Engage with raiders, knightly orders, merchant guilds, and warring kingdoms—or remain neutral and forge your own path.

Deep Mercenary Management

Hire and train mercenaries, equip them for battle, and prepare for every encounter.

Soldiers can rise in ranks, fall in combat, or even betray you.

Real-Time Unit Command

Once battle begins, take direct control of your units.

From individual soldiers to entire formations, every command is in your hands.

Politics and Power

Capture cities, collect taxes, forge alliances, or declare war.

Even a single player can change the course of the world.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-3220 (3.0GHz or over)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX660
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-3770 (3.0GHz or over)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6GB
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: "Start with a handful of soldiers and rise to become a lord who shakes the battlefield!" The game is a medieval-style strategy/real-time combat RPG. Explore a vast land, raise your knights, and conquer new territories. A free mercenary, a loyal noble, or the ruler of an empire. Choose your path.
